title: Automated verifier for quantization calibration with hypothesis tracking
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Build an automated validation harness that verifies model accuracy after calibration/quantization (FP8/INT8) using curated golden prompt cohorts and hypothesis-tracking. This ticket constructs the verifier (Delta Assertor) that runs nightly and on-rollout, computes cohort-level metrics, applies statistical gates, and emits deterministic pass/fail decisions with human-readable rationale for rollbacks and canary promotion. The verifier must be dataset-agnostic (accepts cohort manifests), support adversarial injection, and produce artifacts consumable by the Console rollout system.
acceptance_criteria: A validator pipeline (k8s job + runner) that loads a candidate quantized model and runs N configurable golden cohorts within budgeted tokens
Cohort-level metrics: exact-match/ROUGE/BLEU where relevant, embedding-similarity delta, and distributional drift (MMD) are computed and stored to the metrics store
A hypothesis tracker records each test case group with null hypothesis and alpha, returning a pass/fail verdict plus p-values and confidence intervals
Gate configuration file (YAML) is supported and the verifier enforces gates producing a machine-readable verdict object for the rollouts service
Integration smoke-test: when the verifier returns FAIL, a canary rollout is blocked and an automatic fallback to the previous model is triggered in the staging pipeline (simulated in CI)
Telemetry surfaced in Console: per-cohort delta, top-10 failing prompts, and time-to-validate metrics
test_plan: 1) Unit tests for metric calculators (embedding sim, MMD, bootstrap CIs)
2) Integration test in CI that loads a known-good FP32 model and a candidate INT8 model (with a synthetic regressed slice) and verifies FAIL is emitted
3) Nightly backfill run against the last 30 production queries (anonymized) to validate stable baselines
4) Adversarial injection: insert 5% adversarial prompts from the adversarial corpus and verify the harness correctly attributes failures to the injected cohort
5) Canary simulation: run the harness in dry-run mode hooked to the rollout engine and confirm no automatic promotion occurs when gates fail
rollout_plan: Phase 1: implement standalone verifier service with CLI and Docker image; test on internal models
Phase 2: integrate with canary workflow in staging and add Console dashboard hooks
Phase 3: enable scheduled nightly runs and alerts for regressions above threshold
Phase 4: opt-in enterprise feature: per-customer golden cohorts and stricter gates
risks: If cohort curation is poor, false positives/negatives will block valid rollouts
Statistical tests can be underpowered for small cohorts leading to flaky gates
Running full golden suites is token-expensive and may increase cost during heavy rollout activity
Edge-case differences (tokenization changes between baseline and quantized variants) may skew metric deltas
updates: 2025-11-13: Initial spike and design workshop. Decided to centralize gate configs in Console and keep the verifier stateless (reads model artifact + cohort manifest)
2025-11-18: Prototype metric calculators completed (embedding cosine/delta, MMD). PR opened for embedding metric tests.
2025-11-25: Experimented with bootstrap vs t-test for small cohorts; bootstrap chosen for non-normal distributions.
2025-12-02: Implemented pass/fail verdict schema and added structured reasons (e.g., "delta_embedding>threshold") for Console display. Hook for automatic rollback mocked in staging pipeline.
notes: Design decision: store only aggregated metrics and top-10 examples to avoid PII leakage; full traces are archived with access control
Future: add automatic golden-curation suggestions by sampling production traffic and clustering failure modes
Consider exposing an SDK for customers to run the verifier on-prem as part of Private deployments
